Class VerifyCudaGraph

java.lang.Object
smile.llm.engine.VerifyCudaGraph
public final class VerifyCudaGraph extends Object
Optional CUDA graph capture for the multi-token MTP window-verify forward (S = numDrafts + 1), independent of DecodeCudaGraph.

Enable with environment variable SMILE_VERIFY_CUDA_GRAPH=1 — this both wires the new stable-buffer / graph-capturable-kernel path and enables real capture (captureEnabled()), mirroring SMILE_DECODE_CUDA_GRAPH's single-flag design. Stage 4 of the verify-CUDA-graph plan validated the buffer/kernel path in a shadow-run mode with capture hard-disabled (a now-removed compile-time constant, not a runtime flag); Stage 5 enables real capture once Stage 4's numerics were validated against the existing eager path on real hardware (byte-identical output, no perf regression).

Bucketed by (batch, windowLen, numPages), mirroring DecodeCudaGraph's (batch, numPages) bucketing plus the extra windowLen dimension (query length is not implicitly 1 here).

    • captureEnabled

      public static boolean captureEnabled()
      Returns whether real graph capture may be attempted (Stage 5: same gate as enabled() — a single flag, mirroring SMILE_DECODE_CUDA_GRAPH).

      true when verify CUDA graphs are enabled and capture has not been disabled after a prior failure.

    • raggedEnabled

      public static boolean raggedEnabled()
      Whether ragged (per-row positions, batch > 1) windows may use the verify graph. On by default with the verify graph; SMILE_VERIFY_CUDA_GRAPH_RAGGED=0 disables.
      Returns:
      true when ragged batched graphs are enabled.

    • maxBatch

      public static int maxBatch()
      Largest batch that uses a verify graph (each captured batch size keeps its own activation pool, which at large batches competes with the DeltaNet checkpoint buffers for GPU memory). Override with SMILE_VERIFY_CUDA_GRAPH_MAX_BATCH.
      Returns:
      maximum batch size eligible for graph capture.

    • canGraphVerify

      public static boolean canGraphVerify(int[] startPositions)
      Returns whether this verify step is eligible for CUDA graph capture/replay.
      Parameters:
      startPositions - per-row KV window start positions.
      Returns:
      true when every row shares the same start position (a homogeneous cohort; batch > 1 verify-graph is otherwise out of scope today, but the check does not hardcode batch == 1).

    • markPersistentLogits

      public static void markPersistentLogits(boolean persistent)
      Marks that the current verify step returned logits backed by a captured CUDA graph output buffer (must not be closed by the caller) — mirrors DecodeCudaGraph.markPersistentLogits(boolean). A shared AtomicBoolean, not thread-local: TP fan-out sets this from each rank's worker thread, and the join point (after every rank's future completes) reads it back on the calling thread.
      Parameters:
      persistent - true when logits outlive the caller's own scope.

    • persistentLogits

      public static boolean persistentLogits()
      Returns whether verify logits outlive the caller's own scope (i.e. are QwenModel's own reused capture buffer, not a throwaway eager tensor).
      Returns:
      true when the caller must not close the returned tensor.
